parameters.name: Acid
parameters.description:
The call ID.

This is the contactId, which is included in the callback events of the softphone SDK.

parameters.name: ContactType
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the call is inbound or outbound. Valid values:

- 0: inbound
- 1: outbound.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center.

parameters.name: PhoneNumbers
parameters.description: The phone numbers to which the SMS message is sent. Separate multiple numbers with commas (,).

parameters.name: SkillGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the skill group.
